name: Tone
description: ToneHistogram, the one display shape every histogram view draws (channel counts summed per bin, the tallest at 1, shadow and highlight clipping flags; the engine does the counting), and LevelsMidtone, where the Levels midtone handle sits for the engine's levels curve and the gamma a handle position means. Used by SuiteUI's HistogramView, Library's develop panel and Photo's Levels.
